hooks.name: Responsible-AI review on AI code changes
hooks.description: When any AI provider code changes, remind the agent to re-check it against the responsible-AI steering rules (no legal advice, always ground/cite, soft-warn not hard-block, graceful Bedrock fallback).

action.prompt: An AI provider file under backend/app/ai/ was just changed. Review the change against .kiro/steering/responsible-ai.md: confirm it does not give legal advice, that search summaries stay grounded only in retrieved community posts, that the gatekeeper remains soft-warn (never hard-block), and that any Bedrock path degrades gracefully to the local provider. Flag any violation.
